_meta.confidence: mechanics reliable; numbers may be stale

main_screen.energy: Energy gates stage attempts and regenerates on a timer (snapshot showed 24/80 with 05:42 to the next tick). Base max energy is 20 for new players; the cap is raised by Privilege Cards and other buffs.
main_screen.stage_energy_cost: The 'x5' shown next to the large yellow Start button is the energy cost per stage attempt - 5 energy per attempt - not a multi-run multiplier.
main_screen.power_level: Power Level is your total combat power (e.g. 8.5M), shown in the top header with a gold arrow/chevron badge.
main_screen.power_level_vs_aurocite: Power Level (gold arrow/chevron badge) and Aurocite (pink triangle gem, seen only on shop and pack screens) are different things and are easy to confuse.
main_screen.gems_not_pack_currency: Gems are the green currency in the top header. They are NOT the payment currency for Privilege Cards or packs.
main_screen.campaign_progress_display: The centre of the main screen shows your current campaign stage by name (e.g. 'Poison Realm') with 'Best: X/Y', where X is the highest wave you have cleared and Y is the total waves in that stage.
main_screen.sky_tower_gating: A banner on the main screen names the Sky Tower floor you must clear to unlock the next campaign level - example text: clear Sky Tower Floor 1500 to access the next level once the current one is passed. Sky Tower clearance gates campaign progression.
main_screen.hub_entry_points: The main screen is the hub for everything else: Hunt (a quick-reward alternative to farming stages), Reach (current campaign progress such as 123-50, which opens the clearance rewards), Guild, Camp (Mystlings), Rankings, Task Center, Friends, and the five bottom tabs Shop, Gear, Campaign, Collectible and Events.
main_screen.temporary_event_entries: Eternal Lode and Contract Mystling are temporary events reached from the right side panel, alongside Island Treasure. Umbral Tempest is a large event opened from the bottom action bar.
main_screen.rotating_deal_timer: A countdown on the left panel tracks a rotating limited-time deal. The source notes most of these are not considered worthwhile to most players.
